description: Gemini 4 Neon passed all 33 frozen Core trials (100%), with a 131-second median agent duration and $13.43737 in provider-reported inference cost.
notes: Eleven frozen Core scenarios, three attempts each, 900-second deadline and one concurrent VM. Core manifest 2026.10.24.2; host harness 23.

Audited all 33 raw results and transcripts, per-round token accounting, completion/deadline classifications, lifecycle checks and immutable execution snapshot. No scoring corrections. Public evidence contains sanitized records and hashes, not private transcripts, reasoning, local paths or VM logs.
Exact google/gemini-4-neon model route through Claux/OpenRouter; distinct from Gemini 4 Hydrogen. Reasoning effort was not explicitly set.

Costs are provider-reported inference accounting, exclude local compute and are not an invoice. Catalog pricing and promotional offers can change. Three attempts per scenario are a small sample; a clean sweep on this pack does not establish general superiority.
observations: All 33 attempts completed within the 900-second deadline and passed immediate HTTP, service-restart and host-reboot checks.
Median agent duration was 131 seconds. All 33 trials include provider-reported usage/cost and transcript recording.
No failed or unavailable trials appear in the completed matrix.
title: Gemini 4 Neon Core via Claux / OpenRouter
